title: HSK 3.11 · 赶紧, 公开, 主动, 争取, 信任
focus: 紧 · 证 · 顿 · 共同 · 杂志 · 停止 · 奇怪 · 复杂 · 慢慢 · 压 · 咖啡 · 采取 · 证据 · 公开 · 取消 · 任 · 信任 · 赶紧 · 紧急 · 赶 · 到达 · 主任 · 争取 · 自从 · 快速 · 亲自 · 公共 · 自动 · 实力 · 主动 · 公布 · 赶快 · 动力 · 赶到 · 公民 · 开发 · 争 · 开放 · 展开 · 发动
body:
Lots of action words here. 公 *public*, 开 *open*, 动 *move*, 赶 *hurry* and 自 *self* each appear in three to five words, so watch how one character shifts the meaning of its partner.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 公 | gōng | public, shared | 公开, 公共, 公布, 公民 |
| 开 | kāi | open, start | 公开, 开发, 开放, 展开 |
| 动 | dòng | move (力 force) | 自动, 主动, 动力, 发动 |
| 赶 | gǎn | hurry, catch up (走 walk) | 赶, 赶紧, 赶快, 赶到 |
| 自 | zì | self; from | 自从, 亲自, 自动 |
| 取 | qǔ | take (耳 ear + 又 hand) | 采取, 取消, 争取 |
| 紧 | jǐn | tight, urgent | 紧, 赶紧, 紧急 |
| 主 | zhǔ | master, main | 主任, 主动 |

## Watch out

- 任 (亻 person + 壬) vs 住 zhù (亻 + 主): different right sides.
- 压 is **yā** almost always; **yà** only in 压根儿.
- 共 in 共同 and 公共: same sound gòng as 供, but 共 means "together".

cards.Example: 鞋子太紧了。 xiézi tài jǐn le: The shoes are too tight
cards.Notes: 糸 thread at bottom + top part (from 臤, firm) = threads pulled tight

cards.Example: 带上你的证件。 dàishang nǐ de zhèngjiàn: Bring your ID
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 正 zhèng straight (sound and meaning) = speak straight, prove

cards.Example: 我们吃一顿饭吧。 wǒmen chī yí dùn fàn ba: Let's have a meal
cards.Notes: 页 head + 屯 tún (phonetic) = bow the head down; a pause, one bout

cards.Example: 我们有共同爱好。 wǒmen yǒu gòngtóng àihào: We share a hobby
cards.Notes: 共 together + 同 same = same and together, common

cards.Example: 我在看杂志。 wǒ zài kàn zázhì: I'm reading a magazine
cards.Notes: 杂 mixed + 志 record (士 + 心 heart) = a mixed record, magazine

cards.Example: 雨停止了。 yǔ tíngzhǐ le: The rain stopped
cards.Notes: 停 stop (亻 person + 亭 tíng sound) + 止 stop (picture of a foot) = halt

cards.Example: 这件事很奇怪。 zhè jiàn shì hěn qíguài: This is strange
cards.Notes: 奇 odd, unusual + 怪 strange (忄 heart) = odd and strange

cards.Example: 问题太复杂了。 wèntí tài fùzá le: The problem is too complicated
cards.Notes: 复 repeated, layered + 杂 mixed = layered and mixed, complex

cards.Example: 慢慢吃，别着急。 mànmàn chī, bié zháojí: Eat slowly, no rush
cards.Notes: 慢 slow (忄 heart + 曼 màn sound), doubled = slowly, little by little

cards.Example: 我压力很大。 wǒ yālì hěn dà: I'm under a lot of pressure
cards.Notes: 厂 cliff + 土 earth (with a dot) = earth pressing down. Lookalike: 庄 zhuāng (广 + 土)

cards.Example: 我想喝咖啡。 wǒ xiǎng hē kāfēi: I want coffee
cards.Notes: Sound loan for "coffee": 口 mouth + 加 jiā, 口 + 非 fēi for the sounds

cards.Example: 我们要采取行动。 wǒmen yào cǎiqǔ xíngdòng: We must take action
cards.Notes: 采 pick (爫 hand over 木 tree) + 取 take = pick and take, adopt

cards.Example: 你有证据吗？ nǐ yǒu zhèngjù ma: Do you have proof?
cards.Notes: 证 prove + 据 basis (扌 hand + 居 jū sound) = basis for proof

cards.Example: 这件事已经公开了。 zhè jiàn shì yǐjīng gōngkāi le: This is public now
cards.Notes: 公 public + 开 open = open to the public

cards.Example: 会议取消了。 huìyì qǔxiāo le: The meeting is cancelled
cards.Notes: 取 take + 消 vanish (氵 water) = take away, make vanish, cancel

cards.Example: 任你选。 rèn nǐ xuǎn: Pick whatever you like
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 壬 rén for the sound = a person bearing a load, duty. Lookalike: 住

cards.Example: 我信任你。 wǒ xìnrèn nǐ: I trust you
cards.Notes: 信 believe (人 + 言 word) + 任 entrust = believe and entrust

cards.Example: 赶紧走吧！ gǎnjǐn zǒu ba: Hurry, let's go!
cards.Notes: 赶 hurry + 紧 tight, urgent = rush urgently

cards.Example: 这是紧急情况。 zhè shì jǐnjí qíngkuàng: This is an emergency
cards.Notes: 紧 tight + 急 hurried (心 heart) = tight and hurried, urgent

cards.Example: 我要赶火车。 wǒ yào gǎn huǒchē: I have to catch a train
cards.Notes: 走 walk + 干 gān for the sound = rush on foot

cards.Example: 我们到达北京了。 wǒmen dàodá Běijīng le: We've reached Beijing
cards.Notes: 到 arrive + 达 reach (辶 walk + 大) = arrive at

cards.Example: 他是我们的主任。 tā shì wǒmen de zhǔrèn: He's our director
cards.Notes: 主 main + 任 appointed post = person in charge

cards.Example: 我们要争取胜利。 wǒmen yào zhēngqǔ shènglì: We must strive to win
cards.Notes: 争 struggle + 取 take = struggle to take, strive for

cards.Example: 自从他走了，我很想他。 zìcóng tā zǒu le, wǒ hěn xiǎng tā: I've missed him since he left
cards.Notes: 自 from + 从 from = from that point on

cards.Example: 他快速地跑了。 tā kuàisù de pǎo le: He ran off fast
cards.Notes: 快 quick + 速 speed (辶 walk + 束 shù sound) = quick speed

cards.Example: 他亲自来了。 tā qīnzì lái le: He came in person
cards.Notes: 亲 close, own + 自 self = by one's own self

cards.Example: 这是公共厕所。 zhè shì gōnggòng cèsuǒ: This is a public toilet
cards.Notes: 公 public + 共 shared = shared by the public

cards.Example: 门是自动的。 mén shì zìdòng de: The door is automatic
cards.Notes: 自 self + 动 move = moves by itself

cards.Example: 他很有实力。 tā hěn yǒu shílì: He's really capable
cards.Notes: 实 real, solid + 力 strength = real strength

cards.Example: 他主动帮我。 tā zhǔdòng bāng wǒ: He offered to help me
cards.Notes: 主 master, oneself + 动 move = move on your own, proactive

cards.Example: 成绩公布了。 chéngjì gōngbù le: The results are out
cards.Notes: 公 public + 布 spread = spread to the public

cards.Example: 赶快回家吧！ gǎnkuài huíjiā ba: Hurry home!
cards.Notes: 赶 hurry + 快 quick = hurry quickly

cards.Example: 你是我的动力。 nǐ shì wǒ de dònglì: You're my motivation
cards.Notes: 动 move + 力 force = force that moves, drive

cards.Meaning: to hurry to, arrive in time
cards.Example: 他及时赶到了。 tā jíshí gǎndào le: He got there in time
cards.Notes: 赶 hurry + 到 arrive = rush and arrive

cards.Example: 我是中国公民。 wǒ shì Zhōngguó gōngmín: I'm a Chinese citizen
cards.Notes: 公 public + 民 people = member of the public, citizen

cards.Example: 他们在开发新游戏。 tāmen zài kāifā xīn yóuxì: They're developing a new game
cards.Notes: 开 open + 发 send out, develop = open up and develop

cards.Example: 你们别争了。 nǐmen bié zhēng le: Stop arguing
cards.Notes: Originally two hands pulling at one object = tug-of-war, contend. Also in 净, 静

cards.Example: 公园早上开放。 gōngyuán zǎoshang kāifàng: The park opens in the morning
cards.Notes: 开 open + 放 release = open and let in

cards.Example: 把地图展开。 bǎ dìtú zhǎnkāi: Unfold the map
cards.Notes: 展 spread out + 开 open = spread open

cards.Example: 车发动不了。 chē fādòng bùliǎo: The car won't start
cards.Notes: 发 send out + 动 move = set moving, start
